acceptance: Workflow structure test: schedule, dispatch, skip-if-unchanged logic, same shard matrix as release-v2 (asserted against the live release-v2.yml so the two cannot drift), evidence names include the source sha
G12 calibration: at least one hosted dispatch run completes before this item is done; its wall time, runner-hours and per-shard pass state are recorded on this item
Skip logic proven live: a dispatch with no relevant change since the last green run exits in under 5 minutes with a clear 'skipped: unchanged since <sha>' summary
Per-cell history for the calibration run is readable by a script (the input that rv2r-04 and rv2r-11 consume)
No change to stage configs, timeouts, memory limits, validators or floors
context: Member of batch release-v2-remediation. Prior art: release-v2.yml uat-stage1/2/3 (parallel since #3946), the deleted release-uat-dryrun workflow (do not resurrect as throwaway). GUARDRAILS: 16 shards hold 16 of 20 Free-plan concurrent jobs for about 3 h, so the schedule must stay at 02:00 UTC, and a concurrency group must prevent overlapping runs. Do not edit tests/uat or docker/ until 0.5.0 is on PyPI (rc5->final reuse). DECISION GATE: if calibration shows more than 30 runner-hours per run, or the matrix cannot finish within the 6 h job limit, stop and ask the owner.
description: Owner decision 2026-11-05: UAT becomes a continuous property of trunk. Add a scheduled workflow (02:00 UTC, plus workflow_dispatch) that runs the three release-gate stage configs as the parallel shard jobs release-v2 already uses, against the trunk dist of the newest develop commit that has one. It skips when nothing under benchbox/, tests/uat/, tests/utilities/, docker/, Makefile or uv.lock changed since the last green run. Reuse the release-uat-env action, the shard matrix and make uat-gate-check; do not fork the harness. Each run uploads shard evidence and a gate summary (90-day retention) bound to the source commit and dist digest, and appends per-cell results (terminal state, elapsed time, peak memory, failure signature) to a history artifact or a dedicated data branch, so flake and envelope data exist between releases.
